  "Color", options "Red" (description "Warm"), "Blue"

  you want?" header "Toppings", options "Cheese"
  (description "Melty"), "Olives" (description "Salty"),
  "Basil" (description "Fresh"). Q3 single-select "Pick a

  "Compact"), "Large" (description "Roomy"); each Q3 option
  has a preview that is a 3-line ASCII box using only + -
  | and letters. Nothing else.
